summary: Iteration 2 testing of BitsNdBricks Phase-1 (admin auth + email best-effort + sitemap + optional submission + new fields + full States/UT list + expired tenders in listing). Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed covering admin JWT gate (401 without token, 401 wrong password, token grants access to /api/admin/jobs & /tenders), public listings (jobs no expired, tenders include_expired=true returns is_expired flag), minimal submissions (kind-only) succeed and are hidden from public, collar_type/trade/authority_type persist and return on public detail, and sitemap.xml is valid XML with homepage/jobs/tenders/submit/legal + per-listing URLs. Frontend: /admin login gate works (wrong pwd stays, correct pwd shows admin-create-button, logout returns to gate, re-login works), Submit form both kinds succeed with only a title (submit-success shown), full States+UT list rendered (Delhi, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, Puducherry, Chandigarh, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Dadra & Nagar Haveli all present), Tenders listing shows Open badges (no expired seed data currently exists, so Expired badge not observed in-DOM but flag+UI logic verified in code), TenderDetail shows tender-status pill ('Open'), JobDetail shows 'Applicant Contact' heading, and sitemap.xml renders as application/xml with all expected paths.
action_items: Optional: seed at least one archived/expired tender so the 'Expired' badge and TenderDetail 'Expired' status pill can be visually verified end-to-end in a live environment (currently no expired tender exists in DB, so only 'Open' path was exercised via UI). Backend include_expired path is verified by tests.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_guard middleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api_router). FastAPI middleware wraps the app regardless of insertion order relative to routes so this works, but placing the middleware registration before include_router (or using a Depends() guard) is more idiomatic and easier to reason about.

hmac.compare_digest is used for the admin password check (good), but ADMIN_PASSWORD defaults to a hardcoded 'bitsadmin123' if env is missing — acceptable for MVP but consider fail-fast when unset in production.
JWT_SECRET falls back to 'change-me' when env is not set. In production this should refuse to start or be auto-generated per boot and logged as ephemeral.
sitemap uses SITE_URL from env; if unset, URLs become '/jobs' etc. (no scheme/host). Consider deriving from request base_url as a fallback.

public_view marks is_expired using string comparison of ISO dates against now_iso(). Works since both are ISO 8601 with tz, but if last_date is stored as a plain 'YYYY-MM-DD' (from the date input), lexicographic comparison against the full ISO datetime is still correct — just fragile; normalise on write.

GET /api/jobs/{slug} still returns 200 for archived jobs (only draft/pending/rejected are 404'd). Consider whether archived jobs should remain publicly accessible for SEO, or also 404. Tenders now intentionally allow archived (Expired) — consistent story would help.
test_credentials: Admin password: bitsadmin123. POST /api/admin/login -> {token}; send as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' for /api/admin/* endpoints.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ jobs/tenders + a couple of pending kind-only submissions via pytest + Playwright; all TEST_ and empty-title pending docs were deleted post-run via admin DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now uses admin_token fixture (POST /api/admin/login {password:'bitsadmin123'}). Admin routes require Authorization: Bearer <token>; login and OPTIONS are exempt via the admin_guard HTTP middleware. Submit form fields are all optional (only kind is required). New fields: jobs.collar_type (default 'Not Specified') & jobs.trade; tenders.authority_type. Public GET /api/tenders?include_expired=true is used by the /tenders page. GET /api/sitemap.xml returns application/xml. No expired tenders currently exist in seed data — to visually verify the Expired badge, seed a tender with last_date in the past or PATCH one to status=archived.
